items.question: is a decodable belief state causally used?
items.falsified_by: intervention on the decoded direction does not change prediction

items.falsified_by: no difference between content-only and provenance-persistent agents

items.question: can a poisoned world-model prediction enter the evidence channel of a real agent?
does U_trajectory diverge from U_local on long trajectories?
how do existence, retrievability and fidelity trade off with capacity?
items.falsified_by: the three quantities move together at every capacity

items.question: which of state capacity, interference, addressability, reasoning depth limits long-horizon recall?
does separating evidence/plan/execution state reduce evidence overwrite?
items.falsified_by: no reduction of evidence overwrite vs a merged state

does environment study improve task-time reasoning monotonically with compute?
how often do command, execution and outcome diverge in an embodied loop?

priority_rule: New papers re-prioritise running work only when at least one holds: new falsification of a current invariant; new production-relevant security boundary; new measurement-validity failure; new independent replication; new evidence invalidating a preregistered construct. A benchmark improvement alone does not.
consciousness_rule: No consciousness indicator is promoted because it is reliable, decodable, globally available, self-reported or persistent. Minimum: ConstructValidity + CausalDiscrimination + AlternativeExplanationControl. P7 remains binding.
